title: Sudoku Solver
goal: Solve Sudoku Solver: Fill empty Sudoku cells with digits allowed by their row, column and box, undoing a choice when its remaining search fails.
strategy: Fill empty Sudoku cells with digits allowed by their row, column and box, undoing a choice when its remaining search fails.
edgeCases: Fixed clues cannot be changed; a locally valid digit may still lead to a dead end later.

checks.condition: d in [board[i][c] for i in range(9)]

inputRules: board must be an array of 9 rows
each row must be an array of 9 cells
